shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'README*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 4 'markdown|editor|yfm' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -45 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -110 && npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-catalog.md && rg -n -A 16 'Markdown editor' /tmp/gravity-catalog.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n -C 2 'color-base-(background|float|generic|info|success|warning)|border-radius|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Text Select SegmentedRadioGroup Modal Checkbox && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n -C 2 'color-base-(background|float|generic|info|success|warning)|border-radius|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Text Select SegmentedRadioGroup Modal Checkbox; cat tsconfig.json; rg -n -C 2 'color-base-(background|float|generic|info|success|warning)|border-radius|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0 peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.20.0 peerDependencies --json && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0 @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head -105 && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | rg '(INDEX.md|useMarkdownEditor.*d.ts|MarkdownEditorView.*d.ts|settings.*d.ts|index.d.ts)"'$'"' | head -65 && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg -n 'ArrowLeft|ChevronRight|ArrowUpRight|CircleQuestion|Check|FloppyDisk|ArrowDownToLine|FileText|BookOpen|Eye|Code|Gear|Ellipsis|Xmark' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n 'preview|split|initial|toolbar|change|lineNumbers' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -85 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm | rg '(MarkdownEditorView|useMarkdownEditor|MarkdownEditor|types).*d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-customize-the-editor.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmHtml.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '155,270p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.css | head -150 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/preset-base-types.d.ts | head -85 && rg -n 'export.*(ArrowLeft|ChevronRight|ArrowUpRight|CircleQuestion|Check|FloppyDisk|ArrowDownToLine|FileText|BookOpen|Eye|Code|Gear|Xmark|SquarePlus|CircleCheck)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30 && cat node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json | head -60 && rg -n 'transform|export' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.d.ts | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/README.md && rg -n 'FileText|Eye|Pencil|FloppyDisk|LayoutColumns|ArrowRight|Xmark|Moon|Sun|CircleInfo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/toolbar/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/types.d.ts | head -80 && rg -n 'lineWrapping|lineNumbers' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markup/codemirror -g '*.js' | head -10 && cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install markdown-it@''^13.0.2 && npm install -D @types/markdown-it && sed -n '"'1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts && rg -n 'setValue|replace' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common -g '*.d.ts' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/presets/commonmark.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -55 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/common-editor.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/presets/commonmark.js | head -80 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.js | head -65 && cat index.html'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/common/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/index.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/components/YfmHtml/YfmStaticView.js; cat index.html; cat package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 15 'MarkdownEditorWysiwygConfig' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/modules/toolbars/presets.js | head -110 && rg -n -- '--g-color-(text-positive|base-warning-light|sfx-shadow)|--g-border-radius-xl|--g-spacing-7' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -20 && git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --package-lock-only && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n 'useEffect|change|emit' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/BaseEditor/BaseEditor.css 2>/dev/null | head -35 && rg -n 'initial.*markup|markup.*initial' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.js | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js && rg -n -C 3 'punycode' node_modules/markdown-it/lib/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.js && rg -n 'class CodeEditor|class.*Editor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/markup/editor.js | head -10 && cat .gitignore && ls node_modules | rg 'jsdom|happy-dom|punycode' && rg -n 'process\\.' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/plugins/utils.js && sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/css/lib/stringify/source-map-support.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/css/lib/stringify/source-map-support.js; rg -n -A 35 'setEditorMode' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.js | head -65; rg -n 'change-editor-mode|change\\x27|on\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.js | head -35; rg -n -- '--g-spacing-base|--g-text-display-2-font-size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/common/*.scss; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.js | head -85"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'useToaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.js; rg -n -C 4 'throw|context' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '(useToaster|ToasterProvider)'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts | head -100; rg -n -C 3 'ToasterProvider|ToasterComponent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; rg -n -A 18 'destroy\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/Editor.js | tail -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '95,185p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; git diff --check; npm ls @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components @gravity-ui/uikit markdown-it --depth=0"
